purpose: Restore a native entry point for the existing isolated trial while preserving the approved owned-root containment and complete qualification graph.
preferred_over: preview-placement-correction-proposal-v1.json; that unexecuted proposal would reparent the preview and overstates the original plan's root-type constraint. It remains historical preparation, not current execution authority.
cause: The plan requires an owned top-level root but does not prescribe Frame. The producer selected a Frame; its nested preview has no flow-starting-point inspector and inline Preview displays the whole containing root. This is a producer implementation choice, not a founder product decision.

official_sources.support: Flow starting points are set on top-level frames; flows can be previewed inline.
Sections are top-level canvas elements that can contain all layer types and support prototype organization.

proposed_mutation: Use the observed normal-editor Convert to section action on owned trial root 76:3157 only. Preserve its eight-variant set and preview frame/instance as children. Add one named flow starting point to preview frame 94:3199, if the native inspector exposes it after conversion.
effect_bounds: Only the new root's organizer type changes; no explicit child move, cut, delete, recreation or pasted replacement.

Before mutation verify root ID, type, position, dimensions, children, fill/clip/layout and absence of root reactions. Stop if conversion would affect a prototype-bearing/root-layout behavior beyond the organizer role.

Re-inspect actual IDs, hierarchy and child transforms; do not assume native conversion preserves them. Stop and preserve evidence on any unexpected ID, descendant, property, transform, reaction or source change.
Verify preview remains 320x560 with clip and vertical scrolling; entry instance remains HIGH/MEDIUM/OPEN. Set and all eight variants/reactions remain unchanged.
Create only one labelled qualification starting point. Stop if unavailable; no fallback reparent or additional corrective loop.
Run the same NQ-01 through NQ-06 only after fresh admission; preserve observations and stop on any actual qualification failure.
unchanged_scope: One owned top-level root containing one eight-variant set, one preview and one preview instance
Sixteen native transitions and two no-op observations
Original masters and copied source visual styles
No MCP/AI call, new file, paid feature, original edit, deletion, sharing/account change, application feature, commit or push
authorization_analysis: This is a prospective mechanical correction within the existing isolated-trial write purpose, destination, owned allocation and no-original-edit safeguards. The plan did not mandate a Frame-type root. Required independent review must confirm the bounded implementation interpretation before execution; no new product decision is proposed. If that review instead finds changed material scope/risk or inadequate admission, stop for the applicable founder decision.

independent_review.blocker: Existing reviewer ended with workspace-credit exhaustion; no successor review was executed.

limits: Enabled native conversion is admission evidence only. Its effects and resulting flow-entry behavior remain untested; no original-node equivalence, restore, accessibility, application, full B01 or Phase 1 acceptance follows.
